description: Returns the text of the customer's agreement, as the agreement page of the app shows it. Send search to get only the parts around a word or phrase, for example "house". Leave search out to read the whole agreement, for example for a question about the agreement as a whole. A long agreement comes in pages: call again with the next page until page equals pages.

page.description: The page of the whole text. The first is 1.

product.description: The product line of the agreement. Leave it out when only one agreement is paid.

search.description: A word or phrase. The result has up to 10 excerpts around the matches, not a page.

name: read_agreement

more_matches.description: The agreement has more matches. Send a narrower search, or read the pages.

text.description: A page of the agreement, when the call has no search.

title: Read agreement
